string_literals: {=00bd3Huo}performing new rituals that treat the ruler as semi-divine
{=0Qh7Pa9E}Tenants are forbidden from leaving the lands of their lords without notice.
{=0wxRZ9AV}Armies led by Tier 5+ nobles require 10% less influence{newline}Influence of the ruler clan is reduced by 1 per day
{=1Y5p40uP}granting villagers the right to graze on land held in common
{=2Qx4bL66}The ruler has a monopoly on certain goods, although practically he can license out production to merchants and collect a portion of the proceeds.

{=55CsWKbg}Some kingdoms, especially those that evolved from a city-state or a tribe, had popular assemblies that most of its members had the right to attend. Its powers were often limited, since it could only meet periodically, but it still gave the public the right to participate in government.
{=5WR5DsOz}Rulers could make money fast by debasing the currency and minting more, but this would cause prices to rise.
{=5Wld45hP}forbidding tenants from leaving their lords' lands
{=6DQjKwt2}The influence cost of proposing settlement annexation is reduced by 50% for the ruler clan
{=6kn630ka}Ruler clan gains 100 denars per day for each town in the kingdom{newline}Settlement loyalty is decreased by 1 per day
{=76TgEba5}letting the ruler collect extra taxes in wartime
{=7EP0NgzU}The highest ranking of nobles have the de facto right to assemble large armies.
{=7kNxogN8}appointing independent elders to uphold the law
{=8qwvZ15E}Towns held by the ruler clan gain 1 Loyalty and 1 Prosperity per day{newline}Towns held by non-ruler clans lose 0.3 Loyalty per day
{=9YKV4SNH}restricting what creditor may do to collect debts
{=AlFTInfU}States with strict and formal laws of inheritance make it more difficult to revoke land.
{=AzKq8AfI}In theory, the king or the emperor has the sole right to command men in the field. Anyone commanding an army does so in the king's name.
{=D3W9Qi0Z}All lords have a formal role on the council.
{=DG3JbOa2}For kingdom decisions, the influence cost of the ruler overriding the popular decision outcome is reduced by 20%
{=DIQF5bAX}giving the state monopolies on key goods
{=EG06bDxi}granting awards for deeds in the field
{=FMUlfbJf}Rulers organize farmers into groups of households responsible for supplying troops. This makes recruiting easier, but at the cost of their economic productivity.
{=GFnqIuxy}encouraging lords to appoint bailiffs in their fiefs
{=GwAZMQ8b}Ruler's party size is increased by 60{newline}Non-ruling clans lose 0.2 influence per day.
{=H9Px95rR}Villages grant 0.2 influence per day to the owner clan{newline}Towns gain 1 security but lose 1 militia per day
{=HQGUoRTW}The ruler is considered semi-divine and certain rituals are to be performed in his or her presence, increasing his or her air of authority.

{=InFseOAA}This limits the ability of magistrates to condemn those they consider criminals quickly. It prevents arbitrary abuse of power, but landowners or gang leaders can sometimes use threats or bribes to manipulate it.
{=L9aNOiJo}granting those accused of major crimes the right to trial by jury

{=L9n6yu1X}The influence cost of creating an army is reduced by 30% for the ruler{newline}Armies led by the ruler earn cohesion at 30% less cost{newline}Armies led by non-ruler nobles cost 10% more influence to create
{=LIjN3rYD}Tier 5+ clans lose 1 influence per day and the party size of their leaders is increased by 40

{=Lgmisw4L}This reform limits the degree to which lords and merchants can lend to their tenants and employees and then demand repayment, or seize their assets or their freedom. It effectively bans serfdom.
{=LpdAa1NY}Tier 5+ clans gain 0.5 influence per day, influence cost of inviting lower tier clans to army are increased by 20%

{=MF40cm9k}Land grants are considered to be temporary offices rather than the rightful inheritance of lords. In practice heirs tend to take over their family fiefs, but it's easier under Depositions to remove them.
{=MWvzJSH1}A shift in the tax system that put more emphasis on property and less on the head tax charged to everyone could collect more from wealthy landowners.
{=O4iki0FD}Ruler gains 5% tax from all settlements{newline}Towns lose 1 prosperity per day{newline}The influence cost of declaring war is doubled for the ruler clan

{=O5sBO9sQ}Many empires granted their populations citizenship, which usually came with a series of rights. Of course, citizenship could not be granted immediately to conquered provinces until the population showed it was willing to adopt the ways of the empire, including its language, clothes, and religious cults.
{=OWwPj500}5% of the village income is paid to the ruler clan as tax{newline}5% less village income for clans
{=PG8anNca}Settlement loyalty is increased by 0.5 per day{newline}Daily hearth production at villages decreases by 0.25 per day
{=QLNfsk93}Town security is increased by 1 per day{newline}Town taxes are reduced by 5%
{=QlZc9CNQ}Rulers could appoint magistrates to rule in disputes and solve crimes. This could cut down on gang activity and lawlessness, but was often greatly resented by communities.
{=QoubP07U}allowing the ruler to grant special privileges to towns
{=RbjN7VQ2}Ruler clan earns 3 influence per day{newline}Non-ruler clans lose 0.5 influence per day
{=TsvBHBdX}Tier 3+ clans gain 0.5 influence per day, influence cost of inviting lower tier clans to army are increased by 10%
{=U7s1LycQ}This refers to the practice of appointing independent elders to remind the council of the law and past precedents. It allows commoners without education to make complex legal arguments.
{=UZ0mPm8b}Each notable yields 0.1 influence per day to the settlement's owner clan{newline}Tax from fortifications 5% decreased
{=Vl8BHCvF}allowing the ruler to easily revoke fiefs

{=VzmzX9Ln}This revives the tribunate, an institution in ancient oligarchic republics that gave representation to families without patrician standing. These elected officers could veto legislation from the more aristocratic Senate.
{=W3xUQxAa}encouraging lords to have large private armies
{=XFcmlN1J}Town security is increased by 1 per day{newline}Towns with a security greater than 60 yield 1 additional influence to the owner clan.{newline}Tax from towns are reduced by 5%
{=YOBeOFxY}Town taxes paid to the ruler are reduced by 5%{newline}Town loyalty is increased by 1 per day
{=ZJ2tJnJk}Settlement loyalty is increased by 0.5 per day{newline}Settlement security is decreased by 0.2 per day{newline}Clans lose 1 influence per day
{=ZMTkq5TG}Nobles and other landowners have exclusive rights to hunt in forests.
{=aKLak7nn}giving the ruler broader powers to veto laws
{=aWWzrwAw}The cost of revoking a fief from a clan is doubled{newline}Clans gain 0.1 influence for each fief they own

{=aaUeq1dp}Veterans of the realm's armies are allowed to claim abandoned farmland and receive reduced taxes under the expectation that they will train their children and fellow villagers for future military service.
{=agaSYd5t}Food production in towns and castles are increased by 2{newline}Town loyalty is decreased by 0.2
{=auftprN9}allowing the common people to elect tribes to represent them
{=b4TeiuoJ}Exceptional taxes were often applied in wartime.
{=bDANTRwA}5% tax on tariffs is paid to the ruler clan{newline}Higher trade penalty in towns{newline}Town prosperity is decreased by 1 per day
{=bFEdxs6Y}All clans whose leader has high Charm gain 1 influence per day{newline}All clans whose leader has low Charm lose 1 influence per day
{=bPpdw81a}Daily militia production is increased by 1{newline}Recruits replenish 20% faster{newline}Tax income in settlements are reduced by 10%
{=bhoCBIWB}authorizing the ruler to have a large private bodyguard
{=bxWITUaN}having the greatest lords of the realm meet as a small privy council
{=cBAVR7e8}granting high-ranking nobles the right to summon large armies
{=ceq6ZMIx}Lords can vote to award each other decorations and distinctions for battlefield achievements, allowing them greater opportunities to share military glory with the ruler.
{=dLkfbU0a}Trade tax paid to the town owner is increased by 3%{newline}Town prosperity is decreased by 0.2
{=dvEkfaab}recognizing the common folk in the realm as full citizens
{=eibt105C}The ruler maintains a prestigious personal guard. It attracts warriors who might otherwise serve their local lord.
{=elvb5y2I}The ruler is allowed to impose special taxes on trade in towns, payable directly to the royal or imperial treasury.

{=fjj0pJXV}Landowners could often assert legal rights to common areas and charge villages money to use them. If ordinary people petitioned a ruler, however, he might give them the right to use all common areas for hunting or grazing as members of the village.
{=gOn7a7if}granting lords exclusive hunting rights to nearby forests
{=ieIWHAtc}A ruler can grant towns special privileges based on their 'immediacy', special access to his person without going through lords or other vassals.
{=ifnnu3g4}There is a long list of reasons why a ruler can reject a law passed by the council. A ruler does not need to search long to find an excuse for a veto.
{=kIVfA5cv}Ruler clan gains 5% of settlement as tax per town{newline}Workshop production is decreased by 10%
{=kPqs7EIf}giving the ruler more power to summon armies
{=lXSeaba5}having the lords of the realm meet as a permanent council
{=nP7KOISK}Local landowners have the right to collect tolls on commerce.
{=nmnp9S7k}Nobles have the right to appoint bailiffs.
{=on2EmlUT}A small council of the greatest lords of the realm. This gives the main clans extra influence, but prevents other clans from climbing into their ranks.

{=qEOXka0Q}+0.5 Loyalty per day to settlements that have the same culture as their owner clan{newline}Settlement militia production is increased by 1{newline}-0.5 Loyalty per day to settlements with a different culture than its owner clan
{=srByX06Y}letting all citizens meet and vote on some issues
{=t8TfagYL}Nobles are encouraged to fortify their estates, and can requisition labor and materials to do so.
{=uCXGZ2YP}Military achievements grant 20% more influence{newline}Troop wages are increased by 10%
{=upK62aLR}allowing lords tolls on roads running through their lands
{=w3GIUD3u}allowing the ruler to collect special tariffs
{=waWOKitN}Offering state-owned land to those who served for years in the armies of the realm.
{=xJ2uDcob}Settlement loyalty is increased by 2 per day{newline}Settlement production is reduced by 5%
{=yXb8bphB}Nobles are expected to raise sizable retinues.
{=zKtJHYuI}Settlement militia veterancy increased by +10%{newline}Village tax income -5%
